cols.name: Athenry vs Annaghdown (1957 Galway JHC North Final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1957–1959 history: North Board Junior final at Tuam Stadium Athenry 6-6 Annaghdown 4-5 (held Annaghdown scoreless in second half). Pre-1966 JHC scored gap.

cols.name: Athenry vs Killimor (1957 Galway JHC Semi-final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1957–1959 history: County Junior semi-final at Gort Athenry 2-5 Killimor 2-3 (late Frank Healy goal). Pre-1966 JHC scored gap.

cols.name: Athenry vs Turloughmore (1957 Galway MHC North Final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1957–1959 history: North Board Minor final Athenry 5-6 Turloughmore 0-2. Pre-1966 MHC scored gap.

cols.name: Athenry vs Ardrahan (1958 Galway SHC)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1957–1959 history: Athenry senior debut at Kenny Park Athenry 3-8 Ardrahan 4-3 (Bobby Gardner late 21-yard free goal). Pre-1966 SHC scored gap.

cols.name: Athenry vs Gort (1958 Galway SHC)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1957–1959 history: Athenry beat Gort 6-5 to 1-11 at Pearse Stadium en route to County SF. Pre-1966 SHC scored gap.

cols.name: Castlegar vs Athenry (1958 Galway SHC Semi-final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1957–1959 history: County SF at Clarinbridge Castlegar 1-9 Athenry 1-3. Pre-1966 SHC scored gap.

cols.name: Athenry vs Castlegar (1959 Galway SHC Round 1 draw)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1957–1959 history: first-round draw at Gort 3-6 each vs reigning champions Castlegar. Pre-1966 SHC scored gap.

cols.name: Castlegar vs Athenry (1959 Galway SHC Round 1 replay)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1957–1959 history: replay Castlegar 3-14 Athenry 2-7. Pre-1966 SHC scored gap.

cols.name: Newcastle vs Carnmore (1959 Galway IHC Semi-final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1957–1959 history: North champions Newcastle won County IHC SF by twelve points 6-8 to 4-2 vs Carnmore at Clarinbridge. IHC scored path gap (final already seeded Eyrecourt 1-5 Newcastle 0-4).

cols.name: Beagh vs Cussane (1958 Galway Junior B HC Final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1957–1959 history: County Junior B final Beagh 5-6 Cussane 3-0 (Joe Coen scored Cussane's three goals). Pre-1966 JHC/JBHC scored gap.

cols.name: Athenry vs Fohenagh (1967 Reeves Cup Final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1967 history: gale-swept Reeves Cup final at Duggan Park Athenry 5-2 Fohenagh 3-5 (club's first major senior title). Pre-1970 scored gap.

cols.name: Athenry vs Mullagh (1967 Galway MHC Final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1967 history: County MHC final at Pearse Stadium Athenry 5-2 Mullagh 3-3 (retained title; Vincent Madden clinching goal).

cols.name: Athenry vs Liam Mellows (1967 Galway MHC Semi-final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1967 history: County MHC SF at Kenny Park Athenry 10-5 Liam Mellows 1-6.

cols.name: Athenry vs Skehana (1967 Galway MHC North Final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1967 history: North Board MHC final Athenry 6-11 Skehana 0-4.

cols.name: Castlegar vs Athenry (1967 Galway U-21 HC Semi-final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1967 history: County U-21 SF Castlegar 5-6 Athenry 4-2 (Athenry missing Gerry Donoghue/Willie Cummins/Michael Mullins).

cols.name: Athenry vs Abbeyknockmoy (1967 Galway U-21 HC North Final)
cols.note: Athenry GAA 1967 history: North Board U-21 final Athenry 3-5 Abbeyknockmoy 2-5.
